ignition.description: Foreman Ada wants the gantry working again. Rumor has it that there used to be mechs in the Scrapyard...

stages.journal: Foreman Ada says the mech blueprints were kept in the Undercroft, the old foundry under the yard. The way down is a hatch in the sentry ruins.
The blueprint is sealed in the warden's vault, at the bottom of the Undercroft. The vault won't open while the warden stands guard.
I have the blueprint. Foreman Ada is waiting by the gantry in the Commons.
The blueprint is loaded into the gantry. Every component has to be made and installed; I can check the gantry console for what's missing. I should get some friends to help me.
The mech is complete! Foreman Ada wants to be there when it powers up.

rewards.text: the pilot wings decal, and 800 Engineering XP

found_art.description: Juno the scrap artist is working on a masterpiece and needs some very particular scrap. I can find Juno hanging out at The Spawn Camp.

stages.journal: I have everything Juno asked for. She's in camp.
Juno needs paint for the finishing touch: the reservoir from the old paint press in the Undercroft. It is apparently "a bit lively". It's behind a heavy door off the antechamber.
I have the Splatterpress's paint reservoir. Back to Juno.

rewards.text: the paintball cannon, 200 paint pellets, and the Overclocked press for the brave

survey.description: Surveyor Pell wants someone to map the Quiet Reach. No fighting required.

stages.journal: I need to scan the five landmarks of the Quiet Reach and bring back three specimens (a glowcap, a skyfern and a ruin orchid). The drone will help. Some paths need a little work to open.
The survey is done. I should return to the Scrapyard and speak with Surveyor Pell.

rewards.text: the surveyor's hat and 600 Xenobiology XP
